# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 in Volume 1; 17 in Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P8](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c10 P20](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0020), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive girl with bright, big blue eyes, a radiant, fair skin tone, and long blonde hair. As her illness progresses, she becomes extremely thin and pale, with a feverish flush on her cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P1](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0001), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005)_

## Personality

Opal has a sunny, cheerful, and lighthearted disposition. She is intensely focused on romance and suitors, constantly seeking attention and admiring compliments. Beneath her frivolous and flirtatious exterior, she harbours deep anxieties about dying and leaving the beauty of life behind.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P12](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0012)_

## Traits

- Flirtatious and obsessed with suitors  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)</sub>
- Vain and fond of compliments  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v3 c4 P40](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0040)</sub>
- Emotional and easily prone to hysterics  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c25 P21](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0021)</sub>
- Fear of dying young and being forgotten  <sub>[v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P12](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching school  <sub>[v3 c10 P20](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0020)</sub>
- Curing warts with a traditional stone ritual  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To be surrounded by suitors and enjoy a lively youth before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v3 c4 P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048)</sub>
- To marry a wealthy, handsome man and have children  <sub>[v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

## History

Opal attends Brierley School alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, where she is known for her vanity and frequent romantic antics. She later attends Regent's Academy to qualify as a schoolteacher and joins the Brierley Debating Club and the Village Improvement Society. After graduating from Regent's, she secures a teaching position in Delford. However, during the winter, she suffers from a severe bout of congestion that quickly progresses to galloping consumption. For months, Opal denies the severity of her illness, continuing to flirt and plan for the future, but she eventually confesses her profound fear of death to Nell. Shortly thereafter, she dies peacefully in her sleep, leaving behind a deep impression on her friends and family.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c10 P20](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0020), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 c14 P1](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0001), [v3 c14 P8](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0008), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley as one of several sisters in the Pettigrew family  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- Attended Brierley School and later studied at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m not scared that I will fail to get into heaven. I belong to the church. But—everything there is going to be so unfamiliar. I ponder—and ponder—and it makes me so scared—and—and—homesick.  <sub>[v3 c14 P12](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0012)</sub>

> I want to live. I want to live the way other girls do. I—I desire to get married, Nell—and—and—possess tiny children.  <sub>[v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>

> It is a shame that we ever fell out. It all seems so silly when you come to die.  <sub>[v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023)</sub>
